**School** necromancy [curse, disease, evil]; **Level** arcanist 3, inquisitor 3, psychic 3, sorcerer 3, witch 3, wizard 3
**Casting Time** 1 standard
**Components** V, S
**Range** close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

**Saving Throw** Fortitude negates; **Spell Resistance** yes
